assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY geometries are provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All derived layers and metrics must be regenerated when cleared official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: FAR, heights, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, flood and heritage controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, engineering feasibility, demolition, or approved scale claim is made.

assumptions.statement: No site visit, interview, co-design, time diary, operator authorization, or demand validation has occurred.
assumptions.impact: Personas, locations, hours and pilots are hypotheses requiring informed participation.

assumptions.statement: Future equity measurement uses consent, minimization, grouped reporting, minimum samples and no identity inference.
assumptions.impact: All time-equity outcome metrics remain unknown until independently reviewed field evidence exists.

assumptions.statement: Operators, staffing, budget, permissions, procurement and insurance are not committed.
assumptions.impact: Implementation phases are evidence gates, not schedules or promises.

assumptions.statement: Package figures and layouts are agent-generated from submitted data and local licensed fonts; precedent media are not embedded.
assumptions.impact: Any future third-party image, mark, portrait or archive item requires separate clearance.
